subject: Data Engineering
title: The Target Credit Card Hack
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Target Credit Card Hack.

hook.text: Hackers stole 40 million credit card numbers from Target during the 2013 holiday shopping season.

buildup.text: The attackers entered through a third-party HVAC vendor that had network access to Target's systems.

discovery.text: Malware on point-of-sale terminals captured card data in real time as customers swiped their cards.

twist.text: Target's security tools actually flagged the malware. The alerts were ignored by the security team.

climax.text: The breach cost Target $292 million and its CEO resigned. Third-party access became a top security concern.

quiz.question: How did attackers initially access Target's network?
options: Through a third-party HVAC vendor with network access
